label: readback-4k-20261121
method: Exact 60-second viewer-visible marker score after 30 seconds of warmup within a 105-second window in one authenticated session per attempt. Host and viewer retain their own whole-window clocks. Stage quantiles describe reporting windows. Arm summaries use the first valid result per slot. Route completion and the 27 unique FPS target are evaluated separately.
route_and_scope: Two isolated Xvfb desktops, Ubuntu host and Mint viewer, authenticated fixed NVENC H.264 over an unpaced SSH forward on the measured Wi-Fi link. Planned CPU/core XGetImage and AUTO/MIT-SHM arms differ only in host readback selection. Valid attempts establish the actual host readback, VA-API decode, and X11 RGB presentation. Observer-visible unique frame counts are local to this workload.
